name: Start Ventures
prepared_for: the Start Ventures team at Banco BiG
position: Start Ventures is the venture arm of Banco BiG, investing since 2016 at seed and Series A in B2B startups across financial services: fintech, insurtech, regtech and cybersecurity. It favours patient, long-cycle engagement with founders building regulated B2B software, and typically joins rather than leads rounds.
lede: I'm a Lisbon-based Product & RevOps manager. Your thesis, regulated B2B software for financial services, is the most direct match I've found: I owned KYC and fraud at 14M-user scale, and LOQR, Fraudio, Zango, Ethiack and Sonant sit right on top of it.
summary: Start Ventures backs regulated B2B software, where product decisions are shaped by compliance, security and long enterprise sales cycles. That's the environment I know best. At Pi Network I owned an AI-powered KYC product, scaling it from about 1M to 14M+ users with liveness checks, human review, bot detection and pentesting; at Vibe.co I built the customer and revenue operations behind a B2B platform. Nearly every company in your portfolio sells to banks, insurers or finance teams, and I can help them from Lisbon, freelance or full-time.

reasons.title: Regulated products are my default
reasons.body: KYC, fraud, liveness and audit trails were my daily work at Pi Network. LOQR, Zango, Fraudio and Wealthkernel build for buyers who think the same way.

reasons.title: Security from the product side
reasons.body: I oversaw white- and black-box pentests and worked on a fraud-detection algorithm. That's useful context for Ethiack and for every fintech that sells to a bank.

reasons.title: Patient, long-cycle B2B
reasons.body: Enterprise financial-services sales take time. I build the pipeline stages, SLAs and health scores that keep long cycles visible and renewals safe.

vc_notes.thesis: B2B fintech, insurtech, regtech and security: the closest thesis to my track record.
vc_notes.stage: Seed and Series A: first scaled product and first repeatable sales motion.
vc_notes.platform: Banking expertise from Banco BiG; no dedicated talent role found.

companies.desc: AI receptionist that handles scheduling, call routing and quote intake for insurance agencies.
companies.why: Voice-AI agents sold to SMB insurance agencies: LLM features with evals and guardrails, plus the onboarding and CS tooling a young SaaS needs.

companies.why: Bank onboarding and compliance is the product I scaled at Pi Network: ID capture, liveness, fraud and edge cases from about 1M to 14M+ users.

companies.why: I oversaw white- and black-box pentesting at Pi Network; productising it for security teams is a B2B motion I know.
